CloudReadiness.MigrationNotes: This ASP.NET Web Forms application has been prepared for cloud deployment with the following changes:
Changes: 1. Upgraded .NET Framework from 4.6 to 4.8 for improved TLS support and cloud compatibility
2. Externalized connection strings to use Azure App Configuration or Key Vault placeholders
3. Added cloud-ready comments and migration guidance throughout the codebase
4. Removed hardcoded secrets from Site.Master.cs - now uses ConfigurationManager
5. Added structured error logging guidance in Global.asax.cs
NextSteps: 1. Migrate to ASP.NET Core 6+ for full cloud-native support
2. Convert Web Forms pages to Razor Pages for stateless horizontal scaling
3. Replace IIS dependencies with Kestrel middleware
4. Implement Azure Key Vault for secrets management with Managed Identity
5. Configure Azure SQL Database connection strings in Azure App Service Configuration
6. Deploy to Azure Container Apps with Linux containers for optimal cloud performance

Recommended: Azure Container Apps - For containerized deployment without IIS
Azure SQL Database - Replace on-premises SQL Server
Azure Key Vault - For secrets and connection string management
Azure Application Insights - For monitoring and logging
Azure App Configuration - For centralized configuration management

ConnectionStringPlaceholders.Note: Replace these placeholders with actual Azure SQL Database connection strings in Azure App Service Configuration or Key Vault references
